test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

India went __forward__ all odds and won the match against West Indies.
solution:
The correct answer is '**against**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part of the sentence, "**against all odds**" is **grammatically** correct as it is a phrase and expresses the intended meaning.
 
• Therefore, **option 3, "against**," is the correct answer.
 
• **Against all odds** means "**despite success being very unlikely**."
 
 
• Eg. He was able to do it, **against all odds**.
 
 

Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence**__: *India went **against** all odds and won the match against West Indies.*
